svg.aria-label: Two-dimensional score fields at three noise levels: orange analytic Gaussian-mixture directions, blue learned directions, and gray true noisy density. Displayed arrows use a 9×9 subset; RMSE uses the full 17×17 grid. Panels share arrow scale and density color scale.
